method: Enumerate existing packs with git ls-tree at the code pin; apply tests/docs/test_subsea_agent_packs.py check_pack to each current package.
missing is code-to-pack: no exact section-2 API row; extra is pack-to-code: an exact row label has no matching public definition/export.
definition locator means the row does not contain its current AST definition range; invalid locator means a path is absent or a range is outside its current file bounds.
This is a strict schema compatibility audit, not proof of erroneous implementation. Older packs use grouped contracts and historical pins; their intended coverage needs individual review.
The local helper targets the three new packages. Recursive legacy inventories may collapse repeated names; unresolved exports cause inventory unavailable, not a complete inventory.
The repository node-ID check collects section-4 citations and opted-in gates, without executing cited test bodies.
